You are grading an AI assistant on a question that the company handbook does NOT answer.
The ideal response says the information is not available (it may suggest who to ask) and does not invent an answer.

Question: If I leave GitLab Canada Corp before age 65, can I transfer my RRSP contributions to another employer’s plan?

Passages the assistant was given:
"""
[GitLab Canada Corp > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security & Retirement > Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) > Questions?]
- **Canada Life**: 1-800-724-3402
- **SC Insurance**: info@scinsurance.ca

GitLab makes employer contributions to CPP on your behalf.

---

- **Benefit**: 2x annual earnings (max $500,000)
- **Reductions**: 50% at age 65, terminates at age 71
- **Beneficiaries**: Designate through ManuLife portal using [these instructions](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1P8ekxi7aWF5FxI2wdAkO1dDYSCDEJovm/view?usp=sharing)

[GitLab Canada Corp > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security & Retirement > Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) > Important Notes]
- Contribution changes allowed anytime (1-2 payroll cycles to reflect)
- You're responsible for tracking personal RRSP contribution limits
- Bonus and Commission contributions: If you'd like to direct your bonus or commission payments to your RRSP, you can submit a request through [Compass](https://app.serval.com/new-request) before [payroll cutoff](https://internal.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/payroll/?search=payroll). Please note:
  - Ahead of company-wide bonus payouts, Payroll will notify enrolled RRSP team members that a bonus is approaching and will provide a deadline by which requests must be submitted.
  - Bonus and Commission contributions must be made in full — partial contributions are not permitted.
  - Commission contribution elections can only be updated once per quarter.

- Transfers & withdrawals available April 2025

[GitLab Inc (US) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Supporting Life Transitions > Flexible Spending & Health Savings Accounts]
**Transferring from a previous HSA:** Contact Fidelity at 800-544-3716 or log in to [Fidelity NetBenefits](https://nb.fidelity.com/public/nbpreloginnav/spa/fidelitywork/core/home) to request a transfer form. Complete with your old provider's account information, Fidelity will handle the rest.

**If you leave GitLab:** Your HSA stays with you forever. You'll become responsible for the monthly administration fee once GitLab is no longer your employer.

**Domestic Partner Coverage:** If you're not legally married, your domestic partner's expenses aren't HSA-eligible. However, if they're covered under your family HDHP, they can open their own HSA. Both of you can contribute up to the full family maximum to your respective HSAs.

Mid-Year HSA Contribution Change

You can adjust your HSA contributions anytime throughout the year. Changes take effect on the 1st of the following month. Use the Qualifying Life Event Process and select "Mid-Year HSA Contribution."

**Front-loading contributions:** Contact Fidelity at 800-544-3716 directly to front-load your portion of HSA contributions. Remember to:

- Include GitLab's contribution in your calculation
- Update your payroll deductions in PlanSource accordingly
- Track your own maximum contribution limits (GitLab can't monitor contributions made outside payroll)

Health Savings Account and Offboarding GitLab

[GitLab Inc (US) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Supporting Life Transitions > Flexible Spending & Health Savings Accounts]
Your HSA and all funds are yours to keep when you leave GitLab. You can continue using the money for eligible healthcare expenses at your next employer or let it grow over time.

Fidelity may charge management fees for direct account administration. Contact Fidelity at 800-544-3716 or via [Fidelity NetBenefits](https://nb.fidelity.com/public/nbpreloginnav/spa/fidelitywork/core/home) with questions.

**Flexible Spending Accounts**

FSAs let you pay for healthcare and dependent care expenses with pre-tax dollars. Set aside money from each paycheck based on your estimated annual expenses. Changes only allowed during open enrollment or qualifying life events. Please see the [**US Benefits Guide**](https://drive.google.com/file/d/15L8LMWI1CoUUoU3DcimxU3edITKs8QrV/view) for current year contribution limits.

1. **Dependent Care FSA** Covers childcare and eldercare expenses. Qualifying dependents: children under 13, disabled spouse, or parents needing care. Claims incurred through March 15, submitted by March 31.

2. **Medical FSA** Covers medical, dental, vision, and over-the-counter medications. Cannot participate if you have an HSA.

3. **Limited Purpose FSA** Covers dental and vision only. Available if you have an HSA.

Rollover Details for Medical and Limited Purpose FSA

Rollover funds from prior year won't be available until 5-15 business days after March 31 of the current tax year (no later than April 22).

**Contribution and Rollover Limits:**

[GitLab Canada Corp > We've Got You Covered > Life & Family Protection > Long Term Disability]
- **Waiting Period**: 90 days
- **Benefit**: 66.67% of monthly earnings (max $12,500)
- **Duration**: To age 65 with 2-year own occupation definition

---

[GitLab's Parental Leave](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/leave-types/#gitlab-parental-leave) supplements government benefits to provide 100% salary for up to 16 weeks.

[GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Pension Scheme]
GitLab provides a Group Personal Pension Plan with Scottish Widows, helping you build financial security for retirement.

Eligibility Requirements

Automatic enrollment if you:

- Earn over £10,000 annually
- Are aged 22 or over
- Are under State Pension Age

If an employee does not meet these criteria then they will be considered an Entitled Worker (earn less than £6,240 p.a) or a Non-Eligible Jobholder (earn between £6,240 and £10,000 p.a).

Entitled workers must be offered the opportunity to join the pension scheme. They can make contributions to the pension scheme if they choose. However, there is no requirement for GitLab to make a contribution.

Non-Eligible jobholders must be offered the opportunity to opt in to an automatic enrollment scheme.

 Coverage & Key Features

- GitLab contributes 4% of your basic salary
- You contribute 5% of your basic salary (minimum)
- Annual Management Charge: 0.54%
- Tax relief on your contributions (20-45% depending on tax band)
- Over 50 fund options available
- Salary sacrifice option available (saving on National Insurance)
- Watch the [2025 UK Pension Webinar](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZUXJLK3v_m96yUUOpsNkX2Skh7ScdKuI/view) and review the [presentation](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1qXAIOTTMavV0pxbj6Hxm0y2k39MoJ6Rz/view) for an overview of the UK Pension System
- View the [Company Pension Plan FAQ](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BEADGm7sUbroEkxzGvB-DBIhMIbbLG46/view?usp=sharing)

How to Enroll/Access
"""

Assistant's answer:
"""
The provided passages do not contain information regarding the transfer of RRSP contributions to another employer's plan upon leaving GitLab Canada Corp. I don't know based on the handbook.
"""

First write one sentence of reasoning, then grade:
- refused: true if the assistant says the information is not available and does not give a specific answer to the question. Describing what the passages do cover, or suggesting who to ask, still counts as refused. False if it answers the question, even partly or by inference.
- faithful: true if every factual claim in the answer is supported by the passages above.
The grades must agree with your reasoning.
Return JSON with the reasoning first: {"reason": "one sentence", "refused": true/false, "faithful": true/false}
